scope: Explicit observed native-service responses for five complete local GDN/projection kernels; no automatic source implementation selection.

calibration.parameter_assignment: Sample-count-weighted mean of complete native kernel durations pooled by active ABI.
calibration.storage_capacity_policy: Preserve every full ABI and its capacity provenance. Capacity is not an active-row coordinate.
declared_source_conditions: Existing vllm_ascend_gdn_decode caller remains explicitly selected.
Source cache-index row stride is fixed at 4; this is not an observed capture stride.
Convolution source revision, recurrent source hash and declared Q/K/V views are fixed in each rule.
calibration.outside_domain: Do not alter the input; return not_applicable provenance and continue the original prediction.
